title: Publish warns when starter kit sample words are still on the site

source.ref: Mega Theme lead 2026-10-26: sample-copy publish warning, the second follow-up after the Starter kits panel (LIVE-1373).

detail: Kit pages arrive with every section flagged sample. The publish modal now adds one warning line, 'N sections still have sample words from a starter kit', and nothing when there are none. Editing any field of a section clears its flag. A warning only, never a gate: an owner may keep the words on purpose. Not built: highlighting sample sections in the canvas, and the entitlement check on add and replace, which needs no new gate because the website editor already sits behind the site-admin pass and a draft is capped at 30 pages on save.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('lib/sites/editor/publish-checks.ts','utf8');process.exit(s.includes('export function sampleSections')&&s.includes('sample words from a starter kit')?0:1)"
verify.evidence: publish-checks tests pass with the new warning case.
